Job: Senior Data Engineer (m/w/d)
Description:
### What to Expect

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Data Engineer to help build and evolve Tesla’s next-generation enterprise analytics platform that powers business intelligence, operational intelligence, manufacturing insights, supply chain visibility, service telemetry, energy operations, and more, all while operating under strict SOX compliance and change management controls. You will design, develop, and operate large-scale data infrastructure in a fast-paced, high-impact environment where decisions affect vehicle production, global delivery, battery lifecycle, Supercharger network, Full Self-Driving development, and energy grid optimization.

### What You’ll Do

* Architect, build, and maintain state-of-the-art Enterprise Data Warehouse / Lakehouse solutions that serve both batch and near-real-time analytics use cases
* Design and implement robust ETL / ELT pipelines using Python and Apache Airflow (or modern orchestration equivalents)
* Develop and operate real-time data streaming and processing platforms using open-source technologies such as Apache Kafka, Apache Spark Streaming / Structured Streaming, Flink, or equivalent
* Maintain platform health – Vertica, SQL Server, Airflow, Tableau etc
* Handle sensitive financial, production, and customer data systems while strictly adhering to SOX controls, segregation of duties, change management, and audit requirements
* Partner closely with business sponsors, product managers, manufacturing engineers, service operations, finance, and IT/security teams to gather requirements, scope projects, and deliver high-quality solutions quickly
* Communicate complex technical concepts and business impact effectively through written documentation, verbal discussions, architecture diagrams, and executive-level presentations (360-degree communication)
* Define, enforce, and continuously improve engineering standards, coding best practices, testing methodologies, CI/CD patterns, monitoring & alerting, and quality assurance processes
* Actively participate in design reviews, code walkthroughs, and pull request reviews across the team
* Stay current with evolving open-source technologies and recommend adoption when they provide meaningful differentiation or operational efficiency

### What You’ll Bring

* Extensive years of professional experience as a Data Engineer, Backend Engineer, or ETL developer building large-scale data platforms
* Skilled with SQL, Python for data engineering (pandas, PySpark, SQLAlchemy, API Scrapping etc.)
* Strong Proficiency with database systems like Vertica, MySQL, SQL Server, NoSQL, OpenSearch, etc. is required
* Deep hands-on experience designing and operating Airflow DAGs in production at scale
* Production experience with at least one distributed streaming system (Kafka, Kafka Streams, Spark Streaming, Flink, Pulsar, etc.)
* Solid understanding of data modeling for analytical workloads 
* Experience building and operating systems under SOX compliance or similarly regulated environments (change control, audit trails, separation of duties, etc.)
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of distributed query engines
* Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes / ECS) is required
* Excellent communication skills. Able to explain technical trade-offs to engineers and business value to non-technical stakeholders

Job: Data Manager:in
Description:

Als Projektleiter:in, Berater:in, Entwickler:in oder IT-Architekt:in ist jetzt die spannendste Zeit, um einzusteigen und in einem starken Team wegweisende Lösungen sowie Großprojekte in den Bereichen Mobilität, Infrastruktur und Logistik umzusetzen.


Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir dich als Data Manager:in (w/m/d) für die DB Bahnbau Gruppe GmbH am Standort Berlin.

Deine Aufgaben:

- Du verantwortest den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung einer Datenmanagementorganisation (Data Office) in der DB Bahnbau Gruppe – inklusive Rollen- / Betriebsmodell, Standards und verbindlicher Prozesse
- Konzern- und unternehmensweit etablierst du einheitliche Vorgaben für Datenerfassung, Transparenz von Datenflüssen sowie Datenqualität (u. a. Validität, Vollständigkeit, Aktualität) und entwickelst ein KPI und Reporting Framework inklusive Monitoring

Aufbau und Management eines unternehmensweiten Datenkatalogs sowie die qualitätsgesicherte Anbindung von Fachbereichen an Plattformen (u. a. BBG DataHub / Modular Analytics Platform)

- Du kommunizierst sicher auf allen Ebenen, moderierst Workshops mit Data Ownern und erstellst entscheidungsreife Unterlagen (z. B. Beschlussvorlagen) – auch für Management und Gremientermine
- Eigenverantwortung, Lösungsorientierung, analytisches Denken sowie Pragmatismus und Teamfähigkeit runden dein Profil ab

Deine Vorteile

* Wir fördern flexible, individuelle Arbeitsmodelle und unterstützen, wenn es betrieblich möglich ist, durch moderne Arbeitsformen, z.B. mobiles Arbeiten.

Job: Marketing Data Scientist (w/m/d)
Description:
#### Join our Community of Solvers

Für unseren Geschäftsbereich **[Consulting](https://jobs.pwc.de/de/de/consulting-solutions)** suchen wir dich zum **nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt** als **Marketing Data Scientist (w/m/d)**.

# **Das erwartet dich**

**Beratung** - Du unterstützt Kund:innen dabei, Marketing- und Customer-Engagement-Strategien datenbasiert zu optimieren und den Wert ihrer Kundenbeziehungen messbar zu steigern.   
**Analysen** - Gemeinsam mit deinem Team entwickelst du Lösungen für Customer Analytics, Marketing Mix Modeling, Attribution, Personalisierung und Next-Best-Action.   
**Modellierung** - Du konzipierst, trainierst und validierst Machine-Learning-Modelle, zum Beispiel für Segmentierung, Forecasting, A/B Testing oder Customer Lifetime Value.   
**Operationalisierung** - Von Datenexploration und Feature Engineering bis Deployment, Monitoring und Retraining begleitest du Data-Science-Lösungen im Marketing-Kontext.   
**Zusammenarbeit** - In interdisziplinären Teams übersetzt du Modellergebnisse in klare Handlungsempfehlungen für Fachbereiche, CRM, Analytics und Marketing-Technologie.

# **Das bringst du mit**

- Du hast dein Studium in Data Science, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Statistik, Mathematik, Marketing Analytics oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich abgeschlossen.
- Du bringst mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in Data Science, AI, Marketing Analytics oder Customer Analytics mit und hast datengetriebene Lösungen im Marketing-Kontext entwickelt.
- Du arbeitest sicher mit Python und SQL und hast Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen wie Azure, AWS oder GCP; Kenntnisse in Data Warehouses, BI-Tools oder Customer Data Platforms sind wünschenswert.
- Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, um Ergebnisse sicher mit Kund:innen und internationalen Teams zu teilen.
- Du formulierst komplexe Analysen verständlich und arbeitest strukturiert, damit aus Daten konkrete Entscheidungen für Marketing-Stakeholder:innen entstehen.

# **Deine Benefits**

**Flexibilität** – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten.   
**Masterförderung** – Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Darüber hinaus bieten wir die Möglichkeit einer Masterförderung für Examensmaster und Spezialisierungsmaster an.   
**Freizeit** – Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Jahresarbeitszeitenkonto (JAZ) sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Restliche Überstunden werden einmal jährlich ausgezahlt. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung.   
**Gesundheit** – Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Neben einer eigenen betrieblichen Krankenkasse bieten wir auch Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie Sportangebote an. Nimm an unserem kostenlosen Betriebssportprogramm teil oder profitiere von einer vergünstigten Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft.  
**Das ist noch nicht alles** – Wir möchten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld schaffen: Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und kreatives Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird und auf das wir stolz sind. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.

Bei PwC Deutschland arbeiten wir daran, entscheidende Herausforderungen zu lösen, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu schaffen und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft auszubauen. Als Teil unseres Customer Transformation Teams berätst du unsere Kunden in den Bereichen Marketing, Preisgestaltung, Sales, Commerce und Service. Dafür setzen wir unter anderem auf innovative Cloud-Plattformen und sind beispielsweise globaler Partner von Salesforce und SAP. In unserem interdisziplinären Team unterstützt du unsere Kunden dabei in allen Projektphasen  – von der Konzeption bis hin zur Implementierung und der Qualifizierung der Mitarbeitenden. Dabei übernimmst du schnell Verantwortung und entwickelst dich persönlich weiter. Finde jetzt in unserem breit aufgestellten und innovativ denkenden Team genau den zu dir passenden Platz!

Description:

Start: sofort
Arbeitszeit: 38,5 Wochenstunden
Vertragsart: unbefristet
Entgelt: EG 12 TVöD
Einsatzort: Vivantes Zentrale Verwaltungsbereiche

## Arbeiten bei Vivantes: Unser Job ist das Leben!

Vivantes ist Berlins größtes Gesundheitsnetzwerk – gemeinsam verbunden in der Arbeit mit und an den Menschen. In über 100 Fachkliniken, Instituten und Pflegeeinrichtungen stellen wir die erstklassige medizinische und pflegerische Versorgung für einen großen Teil der Berliner\*innen sicher. Wie Berlin sind wir in jedem Kiez ein wenig anders, aber eben immer auch ganz klar Vivantes.

## Data-Engineer (m/w/d)

Referenz-Nr.: ZVI1306

Sie möchten Daten aus verschiedenen Quellsystemen integrieren und für das Reporting nutzbar machen? Sie suchen eine Aufgabe, die technische Verantwortung, die Entwicklung von Schnittstellen und die Zusammenarbeit in Projekten verbindet? Dann sind Sie im Ressort IT und Digitalisierung genau richtig und gestalten die Weiterentwicklung unserer Dateninfrastruktur aktiv mit.

Das Resort IT und Digitalisierung hat sich die vollständige Digitalisierung der klinischen Prozesse zum Ziel gesetzt. Im Rahmen der Vivantes Strategie 2030 arbeiten wir Hand in Hand mit Klinikmanagement und Fachanwender\*innen an Optimierung, Standardisierung und Digitalisierung unserer Abläufe. Im Rahmen dieses digitalen Transformationsprozesses entwickeln wir das Unternehmen zu einer datengestützten Organisation weiter. Ziel ist es, Daten gezielt für fundierte Entscheidungen („data-driven decision-making“) zu nutzen und so neue Erkenntnisse und Handlungsmöglichkeiten zu erschließen.

## Ihre Aufgaben

• Konzeption und Umsetzung der Datenintegration aus unseren Quellsystemen inkl. Entwicklung der Datenstrukturen und Ladeprozesse
• Entwicklung von Datenbankabfragen zu Reporting-Zwecken
• Übernahme der Systemverantwortung und des Supports der vom Data Management betriebenen Infrastruktur
• Zusammenarbeit mit (universitären) Projektpartner\*innen bei Konzeption und Planung von Schnittstellen, Datenausleitungen und Forschungsprojekten

Job: Senior Data Platform Engineer
Description:
We are looking for a **Senior Data Platform Engineer** to join the **Data Platform** at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly’s operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

## What you will do

- Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
- Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
- Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.
- Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products.
- Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution.
- Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery.
- Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes.
- Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations.

## What we are looking for

- Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments.
- Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes.
- Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance.
- Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more.
- Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.
- Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty.
- Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries.

## Useful experience, but not required

- DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems.
- Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems.
- GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems.
- Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing.
- Experience supporting analytics, AI/ML, feature-store-style access patterns, or cross-domain product-service integrations.
- Experience with JVM languages and Python, TypeScript, Go, or Ruby.

## What we offer you

At Smartly, we offer a place where you can do meaningful technical work while growing with a global team.

- Inclusive global culture built on trust, transparency, open feedback, and respect for different perspectives.
- Global impact through technology used by major brands to plan, create, optimize, and understand digital advertising at scale.
- Wellbeing support, paid holidays, family leave, and sustainable ways of working.
- Equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities.
- A flexible hybrid workplace that balances office collaboration with focused remote work. At Smartly we work 3 days a week from the office.

## About Smartly

Smartly is an advertising technology company helping brands create, manage, optimize, and understand digital advertising across major media platforms. Our engineering organization builds the systems that connect media, creative, and intelligence capabilities into a product used by customers globally.

We value clear communication, ownership, curiosity, and collaboration across teams. We want Smartly to be a place where people can do strong work, grow, and feel respected.

Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway. We care about strong engineering fundamentals, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to build reliable systems with others. Direct experience with every technology listed here is less important than the judgment to learn, reason from first principles, and ship useful platform capabilities.

## **About Smartly**

Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.

Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. We manage creative and media for 700+ brands worldwide and $6B in ad spend across the largest media platforms, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and TikTok. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it.

Visit [Smartly](http://smartly.io/) to learn more.

Job: Data Scientist (w/m/d) – Applied AI
Description:
## Deine Mission

Eine Stelle, zwei Schwerpunkte. Ob du einen vertiefst oder beide, entscheiden dein Können und deine Vorlieben. AI gehört immer dazu.

1. Knowledge Agents & Agentic Retrieval

Wie beantwortet ein Agent eine Frage, deren Antwort über Tausende Dokumente verteilt ist? Wie erkennt er Widersprüche zwischen Entwürfen und finalen Fassungen? Und wie belegt er seine Antworten zuverlässig?

- Entwickle Agenten, die Informationen über große Dokumentbestände hinweg erschließen.
- Untersuche, wie sich Vollständigkeit, Widersprüche und die Qualität von Quellen bewerten lassen.
- Sorge dafür, dass Antworten nachvollziehbar bleiben und Unsicherheiten sichtbar werden.

2. Machine Learning at Scale

Wir messen das Werbegeschehen bei mehr als 150 TV-Sendern in Europa. Unser Ziel: lineares Fernsehen so planbar und messbar machen wie digitale Werbung.

- Entwickle Prognosemodelle für die Leistung von Werbeblöcken.
- Bewerte Unsicherheiten, Messfehler und die Aussagekraft deiner Modelle.
- Verarbeite große Datenmengen mit Spark auf unserem Cluster und untersuche, wo Datenqualität oder Verarbeitung die Ergebnisse beeinflussen.

In beiden Bereichen machst du aus einer guten Frage etwas, das läuft:

- Experimentiere und evaluiere: Formuliere Hypothesen, entwirf aussagekräftige Tests und lerne aus Ergebnissen, auch wenn diese nicht deine Erwartungen erfüllen.
- Übernimm Verantwortung: Entwickle deinen Ansatz eigenständig bis zum belastbaren Prototyp. Hol dir einen zweiten Blick oder denk mit deinem Team am Whiteboard weiter.
- Arbeite mit Engineering: Begleite die Überführung deines Prototyps in ein Produkt und bringe dein Wissen über Problem und Lösung ein.
- Unterstütze andere Teams: Bewerte Datenfragen, zeige sinnvolle Einsatzmöglichkeiten von AI auf und liefere je nach Bedarf eine fundierte Empfehlung oder einen Prototyp.

## Deine Skills

- Fundierte technische Grundlagen: Bring Kenntnisse in Informatik, Softwareentwicklung oder Data Science mit – erworben durch Studium, Promotion oder praktische Erfahrung. Du kannst deine Methodenwahl begründen und Ergebnisse kritisch bewerten.
- Verständnis für AI: Du musst keine Modelle in PyTorch trainieren. Du kannst aber den Unterschied zwischen Prefill und Decode erklären und wie dieser für Latenz und Kosten relevant ist.
- Eigenständiges AI-native Development: Nutze Coding-Agenten, um schneller zu entwickeln. Validiere den generierten Code, teste die Ergebnisse und verstehe, wie deine Anwendung und ihre Komponenten funktionieren.
- Strukturiertes Experimentieren: Formuliere klare Specs, definiere eine Definition of Done und prüfe mit passenden Tests und Evaluationen, ob deine Umsetzung das richtige Problem löst.
- Offene Zusammenarbeit: Teile Wissen, diskutiere technische Entscheidungen und gib respektvolles, direktes Feedback.

Ein Plus, kein Muss: Erfahrung mit NLP/Computerlinguistik, Agentic Retrieval oder der Entwicklung von LLM-Agenten.

## Unser Stack

- Knowledge Agents: Python (Pydantic AI), TypeScript, vLLM/SGLang
- Daten und Pipelines: Spark, Trino, StarRocks, Postgres und Prefect
- Infrastruktur und Observability: OpenTelemetry, Docker/Kubernetes

Kennst du eher Ray, LangChain, Airflow, passt das genauso: Die Konzepte zählen, nicht die Logos.

## Was dich bei uns erwartet

- Remote Work mit gezielten Treffen: Wir arbeiten überwiegend remote und kommen gelegentlich für Workshops, Team-Sessions und den gemeinsamen Austausch in unserem Tech-Office in Berlin zusammen. Außerdem veranstalten wir über das Jahr verteilt Team-Events, darunter unser jährliches Company Offsite, das jedes Jahr an einer anderen Location in Deutschland stattfindet. Die Bereitschaft, für diese Treffen anzureisen und daran teilzunehmen, gehört zur Rolle.
- Eigenverantwortung statt Mikromanagement: Übernimm Verantwortung für deine Themen und bringe sie selbstständig voran.
- Build \> Talk: Früh ausprobieren, früh danebenliegen, früh dazulernen.
- Hohe Ansprüche, wenig Ego: Wir geben direktes Feedback und arbeiten offen und respektvoll zusammen.
- Weiterentwicklung: Nutze Hackathons, Konferenzen und Community-Austausch, um fachlich dazuzulernen.

Und natürlich stimmen auch die Rahmenbedingungen: 30 Urlaubstage plus frei am 24. und 31. Dezember, Smart Fridays mit der Möglichkeit einer Vier-Tage-Woche, Deutschlandticket und JobRad, Sport- und Gesundheitsangebote, Unterstützung für die mentale Gesundheit, Corporate Benefits, Zugang zu RTL+ und vieles mehr.

Job: Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d) Data
Description:
## How you'll make an impact:

- drive projects end to end: clarify the problem, shape the solution, scope the work, and lead delivery through implementation, testing, deployment, and operation
- build production services, pipelines, and data products in Go and Python, with clear interfaces, automated tests, and strong observability
- design schemas, data contracts, and domain models that evolve safely, handle late-arriving data, and answer real business questions
- build in data quality checks, lineage, freshness monitoring, and clear ownership
- operate and improve the systems you build, including incident response, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency
- work with product, engineering, analytics, and data science to agree priorities and resolve trade-offs and support other engineers through mentoring, code reviews, and clear documentation

## What you'll need:

- senior-level experience delivering and operating production systems in a cloud environment. Experience with AWS or Palantir Foundry is useful, but experience with other cloud platforms is equally welcome
- a track record of building production services in Go or another statically typed language, alongside solid Python skills and the ability to work across our stack
- strong software engineering fundamentals, including maintainable code, automated testing, API design, and observability
- demonstrated ownership of projects from problem definition to production: you turn open questions into a workable plan, make sound technical decisions, and drive delivery while maintaining engineering quality
- experience with data modeling and reliable data processing, or strong transferable backend skills and the ability and motivation to develop that expertise
- clear communication, effective collaboration with technical and nontechnical colleagues, and experience helping other engineers develop
- the ability to learn quickly, work through unfamiliar problems, and make practical trade-offs around reliability, performance, and cost
- experience building recommendation services, working with lakehouse platforms, or handling high-throughput processing is a plus

## What we offer:

- your personal growth is important to us: we offer trainings and learning lunches, tech conferences, a budget for workshops and much more to expand your knowledge and your skills
- flexible working hours support a healthy work-life balance
- our free food offer: in addition to a breakfast snack, we also offer a free lunch in our canteens
- 30 days vacation plus 10 days working from abroad
- free choice of top-notch office equipment (also for your remote work space and possibility of private usage), up-to-date hardware, software and modern office spaces that provide you with maximum flexibility
- collaboration thrives on direct exchange - we rely on 80% office presence and 20% mobile working
- from now a permanent full- or part-time position in a modern office in the heart of Berlin: http://www.axelspringer-neubau.de/

Job: Software Engineer (f/m/d) – Data Platforms
Description:
## Your mission

- Engineer Scalable Platforms: Design and implement technical solutions for Big Data applications in an agile, high-performance environment.
- Optimize Data Flows: Continuously develop and refine our data aggregation pipelines (TV data, advertising, and forecasting) primarily based on Spark and Scala.
- Cloud-Native Deployment: Host, manage, and scale your solutions using Docker and Kubernetes within the AWS cloud.
- Champion Quality: Lead the way in test automation – from unit tests to complex integration tests. For us, Test Driven Development (TDD) is the only way to build reliable systems.
- Tech Exploration: Evaluate new frameworks and tools, share your findings with the team, and help us stay at the forefront of Big Data technology.

## Your skills

- Big Data Expertise: You are experienced with Spark, Hadoop, or similar distributed systems. Experience with Trino, Flowman, or Delta Lake will make you stand out.
- Infrastructure Knowledge: You are comfortable with CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS.
- Quality Mindset: You don’t ship without tests. You value efficiency, clean architecture, and pragmatic solutions.
- Open Source Advocate: You love the freedom and transparency of open-source software (you won't find any closed-source or Microsoft stacks here).
- Mindset: A "let's figure it out" attitude, a hands-on mentality, and fluency in German and English.

## Why you’ll love working with us

- Ownership over tickets: You’re trusted with real responsibility, not just tasks. No unnecessary bureaucracy, no micromanagement – we rely on you to take things forward.
- Build \> Talk: We test what works – not what sounds good. Fail fast, learn faster.
- High standards, low ego: We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. Direct feedback, honest collaboration, no drama.
- Stay sharp: Hackathons, conferences, community – we invest in your growth and keep you at the cutting edge.
- Remote flexibility. In person, when it matters.: You work flexibly remote, with a connection to our Berlin or Cologne locations, where our TV Labs are and we experiment, build, and learn together.
- And yes – the fundamentals are covered too: 30 days of vacation + Dec 24 & 31 off, Smart Fridays (4 days week possible), mobility (Germany ticket & JobRad), sports & health offerings, mental health support, corporate benefits, RTL+ access, and more.

Job: Senior Data Scientist - (Global Search, Consumer)
Description:
**Company Description**

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We enable creative minds to deliver solutions that create impact within our ecosystem. We move fast, take action and adapt. No matter where you're from or what you believe in, we build, we deliver, we lead. We are Delivery Hero.

**Job Description**

Deep analysis. Smarter systems. Real users. As a **Senior Data Scientist (Global Search, Consumer)**, you’ll own the deep learning ranking models behind the search services that power every Delivery Hero platform. You’ll also lead our move to agentic ML research, using LLM coding agents to run hundreds of overnight experiments and turn the strongest signals into ranking gains in production.
Our search functionality spans more than 60 countries and 35 languages, facilitating over 80 million searches daily across four continents. The ranking systems you build will directly shape what millions of customers see every time they open the app.
At Delivery Hero, you’ll shape the global consumer experience for millions of users. Your work will have a direct impact on how we attract and retain customers, creating data-driven, personalized interactions that keep them coming back. As part of our Consumer Team, you’ll enhance customer satisfaction and drive global growth and profitability through innovative projects.
- Own the ranking stack end to end: design, build, and productionize deep neural ranking models (DCN-V2, MMoE, Two-Tower) for high-throughput, low-latency serving, from offline experimentation and evaluation through monitoring and iterative improvement.
- Lead agentic ML research: use LLM coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Gemini) to autonomously iterate on feature engineering and Learning to Rank (LTR) architectures, design overnight experiment pipelines inspired by the auto-research paradigm, and review the outputs of hundreds of runs to identify signals quickly.
- Improve ranker quality through feature engineering and model architecture work, applying your expertise in ranking signals, feature stores, and embedding-based retrieval, and turning the latest research into production-grade systems.
- Keep production models healthy by owning monitoring for model drift, latency degradation, and feature pipeline integrity, and acting quickly when signals deviate in any market.
- Partner with Backend Engineers, Data Engineers, and Product Managers to deliver end-to-end improvements, explain ML trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders, and help shape the team’s roadmap.
- Mentor junior and mid-level data scientists and set the standard for experimentation rigor, code quality, and agentic development workflows.

**Qualifications**

- A Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related quantitative field (or a Bachelor’s with 6+ years of work experience), plus 4+ years as a Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer applying ML in high-traffic production environments.
- Production-proven experience with deep learning ranking architectures (DCN-V2, MMoE, Two-Tower), including multi-task learning, cross-feature interactions, and embedding optimization at scale, plus a solid foundation in LTR methods (pointwise, pairwise, listwise), offline metrics (NDCG, MRR), and the challenges of bridging offline metrics to online A/B outcomes.
- Proficiency with LLM coding agents and agentic CLI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Gemini) as first-class development tools for autonomous experiment generation, architecture prototyping, and rapid iteration, along with familiarity with the auto-research paradigm and comfort reviewing large volumes of generated experiment results.
- Expert Python skills across the ML ecosystem (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn), working knowledge of SQL (dbt), GCP or AWS, and big-data processing (PySpark, Scala), and hands-on MLOps across the full lifecycle: feature stores, vector databases, model versioning and registry, Metaflow, CI/CD for ML pipelines, experiment tracking, A/B frameworks, low-latency deployment, and production monitoring for drift, latency, and data quality.
- Comfort turning broad business objectives into well-scoped data science projects, with accountability for outcomes, not just outputs.
- Experience working in cross-functional, globally distributed teams, and the ability to explain model behavior, experiment results, and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

Working together to make the world a little bit better every day. This is our purpose at EY and as a team we go all in to work towards our bold ambition: to create long-term value and growth – for our clients, our people and society. Our network of around 400,000 people around the world offers you every opportunity to grow, develop, specialize and pursue your professional strengths and interests. Your role
By joining the People Advisory Services service line, you'll be part of a fast-growing team that helps multinational companies manage compliance for short-term business travel. - Work directly with clients to manage master data in the EY Business Travel Compliance software across technical environments (e.g., test and production), with a focus on data quality and standardization.
- Build and improve automated data flows, including data migrations between environments.
- Create reports and dashboards that give clients visibility into their data quality and travel compliance.
- Prepare and lead Data & Analytics workshops with clients to understand their requirements and turn them into data and integration solutions.

Your skillset

- You write production-quality SQL and Python, and you're just as comfortable in a client workshop working out what needs to be built. This isn't pure development or pure reporting. The role is at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, and consulting.
- University degree in computer science, business informatics, economics, mathematics, or a related field, combined with relevant professional experience.
- Strong technical and analytical skills, including SQL, Python, ETL pipelines, APIs, and experience with clean, tested, modular, and version-controlled code (e.g., Git/GitHub, Azure DevOps).
- Experience with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI or SAP Analytics Cloud, as well as advanced Excel skills, including Power Query.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience translating business requirements into technical solutions; fluent German and English (C1 level or higher).


Your mindset

- Agile: You believe that a flexible mindset is just as important for success as knowledge and skills.
- Curious: You are ambitious and committed. We are looking for people who recognize opportunities, proactively tackle challenges, and find better solutions by asking targeted questions.
- Collaborative : You value diverse perspectives and enjoy working in a team. We are looking for people to help us shape the future and create a working environment based on trust.


Your benefits
At EY, you will work in high-performing, interdisciplinary teams with innovative technologies. We support you in your various life situations with our flexible and inclusive working environment. Job: Senior Applied Scientist - Search (all genders)
Description:
THE ROLE & THE TEAMThe Search team at Zalando is at the heart of our customer experience. We are responsible for the core discovery journey of millions of customers, ensuring they find the fashion and lifestyle products they love out of a catalog of millions of items. By leveraging state-of-the-art information retrieval, natural language processing, machine learning, and emerging agentic AI, we continuously improve query understanding, product ranking, and personalized search experiences.

As a Senior Applied Scientist on the Search team, you will be a technical leader in developing and deploying advanced, machine learning models and agentic workflows that directly impact our search engine's relevance and performance. Together with your peers—engineers, product managers, and other scientists—you will tackle complex challenges at scale, drive scientific excellence, and set the standard for how we solve complex ranking and retrieval problems.

WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)You’ll research, design, and deploy state-of-the-art machine learning models for search relevance, learning-to-rank (LTR), query understanding, and personalization, leveraging both traditional ML and autonomous, agentic LLM workflows.
You’ll work with various stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Design) to understand the business context, translate customer problems into scientific formulations, and contribute to developing scalable solutions.
You’ll support the end-to-end implementation of your solutions, from offline model training on massive datasets to online deployment, and measure success through rigorous A/B testing and customer feedback.
You’ll drive scientific and engineering excellence within the team, mentoring mid-level and junior scientists and championing novel approaches using agentic AI systems.

WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IFYou hold a Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Information Retrieval, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, backed by solid, related industry experience in applied machine learning.
A strong track record of publications in top-tier conferences (e.g., SIGIR, KDD, ACL, NeurIPS) is highly preferred.
You have deep expertise in Information Retrieval, Search Ranking, NLP, and hands-on experience designing and building agentic AI systems (e.g., autonomous agents, LLM-based reasoning frameworks).
You are comfortable working with large-scale data systems and modern search engines.
You consistently demonstrate a customer-centric approach, possess a strong product mindset, and proactively flag continuous improvement initiatives within your area.
You take an active interest in market trends and the latest advancements in AI and Search technologies.

OUR OFFERZalando provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer.
27 days of holiday a year to start for full-time employees (+1 day for every calendar year up to 30 days)
40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Lounge by Zalando, discounts from external partners
Family support, including counselling and dedicated services for parents and carers
Company pension scheme
Employee shares programme
Health and wellbeing options, including Wellhub
Mental health support and coaching
Development through our training platform and biannual peer-to-peer review
2 paid volunteering days a year
Relocation assistance (subject to prior agreement)

We actively seek to reduce bias in our hiring and employment processes, focusing on your qualifications, skills, and contributions.  Conceptualize, prototype, and productionize state-of-the-art demand forecast solutions. You enjoy finding solutions to new complex problems and don’t mind getting your hands dirty (with pen and paper or in your IDE of choice).

Job: Forward-Deployed CRM Architect
Description:
RevOps is changing fast, and so is the way GTM processes get built and maintained inside the CRM. This role puts you on the front edge of it: forward-deployed in our clients' RevOps teams, building and running their GTM systems in a genuinely AI-first environment. 
 GTMBase is an AI-first GTM engineering and RevOps agency. We help post-PMF B2B companies (€8M to €50M ARR, 5+ reps) whose go-to-market is over-performing their systems. Reps do manually what should be automated, sales and marketing data doesn't connect, and leadership can't trust the reporting. 
 We combine strategic GTM thinking with hands-on technical build, and we fix the foundation before running campaigns. 
 We deliver across Four Pillars: 
 
  Data Foundation:  list building and enrichment so reps win with better data (Clay, Apollo, custom scrapers, AI research) 
  RevOps & CRM:  building the right GTM process inside the client's CRM, including architecture, lifecycle, pipelines, routing, and reporting (HubSpot, Salesforce) 
  Agentic Workflows:  building agentic GTM workflows with Anthropic Managed Agents and Hermes, getting the org ready for Agentic GTM 
  GTM Strategy & Plays:  recommending and executing the highest-impact campaigns 
 
 We've done this for clients including  Groupon, Blinkist, Booksy, and Sendify.  We work in small pods, with a Strategist, a CRM Architect, and a GTM Engineer. 
 How We Operate 
 We run the company on Claude Code. It's our operating system: client context, playbooks, automations, and delivery all live in it, and AI is the default way we work rather than a bolt-on. You'll work this way too, and get very good at it. 
 Why This Role Matters 
 You're the person who turns our GTM strategy into a CRM that actually works. Most clients run their entire revenue motion on HubSpot or Salesforce, and the quality of that system runs through this role: how clean the data is, how well leads route, whether leadership can trust the reporting. 
 Here, "Architect" means architecting inside the CRM: the object model, pipelines, workflows, and automations. The GTM and revenue strategy is set with you in your pod, not by you alone, and you build it with real craft. 
 You're forward-deployed: you embed with clients' RevOps and sales teams and build inside their live CRM. 
 The Role 
 You'll build and maintain GTM process and automation inside our clients' CRMs, mostly HubSpot. Working from the direction set in your pod, you turn requirements into a clean, well-built system the sales team can rely on. 
 One week you're building a client's lead lifecycle and routing. The next you're debugging a broken automation, untangling duplicate deals, or shipping a dashboard a CRO asked for. You move across several client instances at once without dropping threads. 
 You're a builder with an admin's discipline. You know the object model, not just the UI. You sweat the details others miss, you test before you ship, and you document what you build so the rest of the pod can run it. When something breaks, you find the root cause and fix it properly. 
 How This Differs From a GTM Engineer 
 Your pod is you (CRM Architect), a Strategist who sets direction and hands you requirements, and a GTM Engineer. You and the GTM Engineer are both builders, but you own different layers: 
 
  You (CRM Architect, Pillar 2):  the GTM process inside the CRM. HubSpot/Salesforce architecture, lifecycle, routing, deal logic, automation, reporting, data integrity. You live in HubSpot, Salesforce, Operations Hub, and n8n. 
  GTM Engineer (Pillar 1):  the data layer. Enrichment, scraping, signal detection, list building, custom research agents. They live in Clay, Apify, custom scrapers, and data APIs. 
 
 Think of it as the data into the CRM (GTM Engineer) versus the system it lands in and the process the sales team runs on (you). You don't need to be a Clay or Apify expert. You just need a solid working understanding of what a GTM Engineer does, enough to spec what you need, integrate their output cleanly, and know what's possible. 
 What You'll Do 
 
  Architect and build in client HubSpot instances:  information architecture (objects, associations, lifecycle stages, pipeline structure), workflows, deal logic, lead scoring, routing, properties, and permissions 
  Build and debug automations  across the GTM stack: HubSpot workflows, n8n, APIs, and webhooks. When an automation breaks, you find the root cause rather than just toggling features 
  Guard data integrity:  deduplication, field validation, association hygiene, and import discipline so reporting and forecasting can be trusted 
  Build the reporting leadership relies on:  pipeline coverage and velocity, stage-by-stage conversion, and full-funnel dashboards. You know where HubSpot's platform and paywall limits force a different approach 
  Design integrations and data flows  between HubSpot and the rest of the stack (Clay, Aircall, telephony, billing, enrichment pipelines) 
  Turn requirements into working builds:  take a brief like a 15-minute lead-response SLA and ship the routing system that delivers it 
  Keep multiple client instances healthy  at once, with fast turnaround and nothing falling through the cracks 
  Work client-facing:  you can talk through a data question with a technical lead and walk a frustrated AE through a new flow in the same afternoon 
  Codify what works  into our library of reusable plays and patterns, so every client build sharpens the whole team 
 
 What We're Looking For 
  Must-have  
 
  Deep HubSpot expertise:  hands-on across Sales, Marketing, Service, and Operations Hubs. You know HubSpot well enough to know what is and isn't possible at the platform level, and to choose native functionality over a workaround when it's the right call. 
  Strong CRM and RevOps fundamentals:  lead lifecycle and qualification, routing and assignment, pipeline and deal-stage setup, the data model, and the governance that keeps it clean. 
  An admin's discipline:  precise, reliable, and detail-obsessed. You test before you ship, you keep data clean, and you don't let things fall through the cracks. 
  A builder's instinct:  you build workflows and integrations, debug them when they break, and aren't intimidated by APIs, webhooks, or a tool you haven't used yet. 
  AI-first, and we mean it literally:  AI is your default operating mode, not a novelty. Your first move on a problem is to reach for an agent, a prompt, or a workflow before a manual process. If you're not already using AI tools daily, this isn't the right fit. (If your CRM fundamentals are deep but your GTM-tooling experience like Clay or Claude Code is light, that part is learnable and we'll back you on it. The fundamentals and the AI-first instinct are not.) 
  Forward-deployed temperament:  comfortable building across multiple clients in parallel, client-facing, proactive, and able to move fast without waiting for perfect requirements. 
  Full-time availability  with reliable overlap to CET hours. 
 
  Nice-to-have  
 
  Salesforce:  admin or build experience, especially HubSpot to Salesforce sync and migrations (relevant to Groupon and enterprise work) 
  A working understanding of the GTM Engineer's toolkit:  Clay, Apify, enrichment providers (ZoomInfo, Apollo, Clearbit), scraping. Enough to collaborate, spec, and integrate. Your pod's GTM Engineer owns the deep builds. 
  n8n  orchestration and custom API integrations 
 Scripting (Python, SQL, or JavaScript) for data manipulation and custom connectors 
  German:  a good chunk of our client base is DACH 
 HubSpot certifications: a plus, never a gate. Demonstrated depth matters more. 
 
 What You'll Get 
 
 Real client build work from day one, with no busy work and no hand-holding 
 A front-row seat in a genuinely AI-first environment: Claude Code as the operating system, Clay, and the full modern GTM stack 
 Direct collaboration with one of the most experienced RevOps leaders in Europe  
 Exposure to a wide range of B2B companies, stacks, and GTM problems 
 A seat at the table in a growing practice, not a cog in a machine

Job: Marketing & Brand Activation Manager
Description:
Bei  LIMITD  revolutionieren wir den deutschen Einzelhandel mit Influencer-Produkten. Seit 2020 arbeiten wir eng mit Creatorn wie CrispyRob, HeyMoritz und Emir Bayrak zusammen, um Produkte für die Gen Z zu entwickeln. Mit unseren Marken  ROB’s ,  HEYYY  und  EMYO  bringen wir die Power der Social Media Communities in die Regale. 
 In unserem schnell wachsenden Startup setzen wir auf Innovation und Authentizität, um den Lebensmitteleinzelhandel neu zu definieren – und freuen uns, wenn du dabei bist! 
 Aufgaben 
 
 Du bist verantwortlich für die Planung, Organisation und Umsetzung von Brand Activation Maßnahmen rund um unsere Marken. 
 Du betreust und koordinierst markenbezogene Events, Pop-ups, Store-Aktivierungen, Festivals, Touren, Sponsorings und weitere On-the-Ground-Marketingmaßnahmen – von der Idee bis zur finalen Umsetzung. 
 Du planst und organisierst kreative Produkt-Launches sowie Influencer- und Creator-Sampling-Kampagnen für neue Produkte und Aktionen. 
 Du koordinierst externe Dienstleister, Agenturen, Produktionen und Partner und übernimmst die Verhandlung von Angeboten, Timings und Budgets. 
 Du arbeitest eng mit Künstlern, Managements und externen Partnern zusammen und bist zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Marketing, Sales und externen Dienstleistern. 
 Du unterstützt bei der Planung und Umsetzung von Content-Produktionen, Creator-Aktionen und markenbezogenen Kampagnen. 
 Du baust aktiv Beziehungen zu Influencern, Managements und relevanten Partnern innerhalb der Creator- und Social-Media-Welt auf und pflegst diese langfristig. 
 Du betreust unser Influencer-Seeding sowie die Organisation von Produktmustern, Merchandise, Marketingmaterialien und Event-Assets. 
 Du unterstützt bei der Organisation und Umsetzung von Messen, Retail-Aktivierungen und weiteren B2B-Marketingmaßnahmen. 
 Du behältst Timings, Budgets, Logistik und Projektabläufe im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte effizient und erfolgreich umgesetzt werden. 
 
 Qualifikation 
 
 Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium mit Schwerpunkt Marketing, Medienmanagement, Eventmanagement oder vergleichbar. 
 Du konntest bereits erste relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich Marketing, Brand Activation, Events, Influencer Marketing oder Projektmanagement sammeln. 
 Du interessierst dich für die Creator Economy, Social Media, digitale Trends und die deutschsprachige Influencer- und Creator-Szene. 
 Du bist organisiert, strukturiert und behältst auch in dynamischen und stressigen Situationen den Überblick. 
 Du bringst eine starke Hands-on-Mentalität mit und hast Lust, Dinge eigenständig voranzutreiben und umzusetzen. 
 Du bist kommunikativ, kreativ und verfügst über ein gutes Gespür für Marken, Zielgruppen und aktuelle Trends. 
 Du arbeitest gerne mit Menschen zusammen und kannst sicher mit Künstlern, Influencern, Managements, Agenturen und externen Partnern kommunizieren. 
 Du besitzt Verhandlungsgeschick sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Budgets, Projektplanung und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge. 
 Du bist flexibel, reisebereit und hast Freude daran, Projekte und Events auch direkt vor Ort zu begleiten. 
 Erfahrungen im Bereich Eventorganisation, Influencer Relations, Creator Marketing, Sampling, Content-Produktion oder FMCG sind ein Plus. 
 Ein bestehendes Netzwerk innerhalb der Influencer- oder Creator-Szene ist hilfreich, aber kein Muss.

Job: Projektleiter Bau (m/w/d)
Description:
Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass Padel ein magischer Sport ist – einer, der Menschen durch seine einzigartige Kombination aus Leichtigkeit, Dynamik und sozialer Interaktion begeistert. Padel ist für alle da: von Jung bis Alt, vom Anfänger bis zum Profi – jeder kann an dieser Leidenschaft teilhaben. Es ist mehr als nur ein Spiel; es ist ein Erlebnis, das verbindet, Freude bereitet und Freundschaften schafft. 
  mitte ist ein Boutique Padel Club , der erstklassige Spielbedingungen und ein stilvolles Umfeld für unsere dynamische, moderne Community bietet. Unsere Clubs kombinieren hochwertige Einrichtung in zentralen innerstädtischen Standorten mit digitaler Innovation und menschlicher Wärme, um Padel zu einem festen Bestandteil des Alltags zu machen – sei es für ein schnelles Spiel oder als „Third Place“ für verschiedenste Erlebnisse. 
  Was uns besonders macht:  
 
 Unsere  Indoor-Clubs  sind so gelegen, dass man sie in  unter 15 Minuten  erreichen kann – ideal für den urbanen Alltag 
 Unsere  vollautomatisierten Systeme  sorgen für ein reibungsloses, modernes Spielerlebnis 
 Unsere  Community Leader  leben Gastfreundschaft und hospitality-like Betreuung und widmen sich voll und ganz der Aufgabe, hervorragende Gastgeber zu sein 
 Unser  Interior Design  stammt von einem renommierten Boutique-Architekten 
 
 Unsere Ambition:  Die globale Brand für Premium Padel  zu werden. 
 Aufgaben 
 Als Projektleiter Bau (m/w/d) verantwortest du die bauliche Realisierung unserer Clubs vor Ort. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem internen Architekten, externen Designpartnern, Fachplanern und ausführenden Gewerken zusammen und stellst sicher, dass jeder neue Club in Zeit, Budget und Qualität entsteht. 
 Dein Ziel: eine reibungslose Bauausführung über mehrere Standorte parallel – mit dem Anspruch, dass jeder neue Club schneller, präziser und besser wird als der vorherige. 
  Deine Aufgaben:  
 
  Bauliche Projektsteuerung:  Du verantwortest die Bauausführung mehrerer Standorte parallel – von der Vergabe über die Bauüberwachung bis zur Abnahme. 
  Bauüberwachung vor Ort:  Du überwachst die Bauausführung, führst Abnahmen durch, dokumentierst den Fortschritt und stellst die Einhaltung von Kosten, Terminen und Qualität sicher. 
  Vergabe & Gewerke-Koordination:  Du verantwortest den Vergabeprozess, formulierst und adaptierst Leistungsverzeichnisse aus unseren Standards, wertest Angebote aus und triffst fundierte Vergabeentscheidungen. 
  Schnittstellen-Management:  Du koordinierst die Schnittstellen zwischen unserem internen Architekten, MAG Design, Fachplanern und ausführenden Gewerken – und sorgst dafür, dass der mitte-Standard in jedem Detail umgesetzt wird. 
  Mängelmanagement & Gewährleistung:  Du begleitest die Mängelbeseitigung nach Fertigstellung und sicherst die Gewährleistungsverfolgung. 
  Skalierbare Standards:  Du entwickelst die baulichen Module – von Fit-out bis Touch-up – kontinuierlich weiter und standardisierst sie, um Skaleneffekte zu erreichen und Bauzeiten zu reduzieren. 
  Schnittstellen:  Du arbeitest eng mit Architektur, Investment und Launch zusammen und stellst sicher, dass jeder Club rechtzeitig und in mitte-Qualität zur Eröffnung bereitsteht. 
 
  Das Besondere an dieser Rolle ist, dass…  
 
  du den baulichen Skalierungs-Motor von mitte verantwortest  – jeder Club, den du in Betrieb bringst, ist ein Stück Unternehmensentwicklung. 
  du echte Multi-Projekt-Verantwortung trägst  – nicht eine Baustelle, sondern viele parallel. 
  du an der Schnittstelle von Bau, Design und Operator-Geschäft arbeitest  – mit dem Anspruch, dass das Ergebnis nicht nur funktioniert, sondern Premium-Qualität hat.
